id: ISS-0950
title: "Catalog service endpoint_url is not URL-validated at registration/publish time (decision 0027 gap)"
discovered_by: SECURITY-REVIEWER
discovered_in_run: WF03-ISS0917-20261001 (filed by ORCH)
discovered_at: "2026-10-01T14:06:29Z"
severity: MINOR
owner: "ELIXIR-DEV"
description: >
  Found by SECURITY-REVIEWER in WF03-ISS0917-20261001. POST /service-catalog and publish do no
  UrlValidator check on endpoint_url; the only control is the dispatch-time INV-9 gate in
  ServiceTaskDispatcher.http_transport/3. ISS-0917's fix makes catalog endpoints reachable by the
  dispatcher for the first time, so add fast-feedback syntactic validation (https scheme, host not
  private/loopback literal) at register/publish time in Letflow.ServiceCatalog /
  Routers.AdminServices. Defense in depth; dispatch gate stays binding. Severity MINOR (hardening).
  Owner ELIXIR-DEV (via CODE-DESIGNER).
affected_files:
  - lib/letflow/service_catalog.ex
  - lib/letflow/routers/admin_services.ex
queue_ref: Q-921  # queue issue_ref ISS-0921 collides with an existing local file; local filename ISS-0950
github_ref: GH-2095
status: open

task.description: WF-03 Step 3c SECURITY-REVIEWER gate (tenant-data / SSRF path). Review the implementation commit(s) on branch feature/WF03-ISS0950-20261001 vs origin/main (git diff origin/main...HEAD -- lib/ test/) against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md (INV-9 SSRF in particular) and decision 0027, and the validated design lib/letflow/design/iss0950-catalog-endpoint-url-register-validation.md. Check with evidence (read code; run scoped probes outside the repo or with a throwaway scratch script you delete): (1) validate_syntactic/1 cannot be bypassed by URL forms: userinfo tricks (https://good@127.0.0.1/), decimal/octal/hex IPv4 forms, IPv4-mapped IPv6, bracketed ::1, uppercase scheme, trailing dot, whitespace/control chars, backslashes, templates placing {{ }} to smuggle a host (e.g. https://{{variables.h}}/, https://a{{x}}.b/, https://127.0.0.1{{x}}/ , https://example.test@{{variables.h}}/), unicode/IDN; (2) the template head/tail split cannot be fooled (e.g. placeholder in path after which URI.parse host differs; '?' or '#' or backslash before the host terminator); (3) the check applies on BOTH insert and publish incl. unchanged republish (get_field), and no other endpoint_url write path was missed; (4) dispatch gate (ServiceTaskDispatcher.http_transport) and validate/1,2 behaviour are unchanged (diff), so defense in depth is genuinely additive and the register check is not relied upon as the control; (5) error message leaks nothing sensitive; no DNS at register time (no SSRF/timing via resolver). Report any gap with severity. A bypass of the register-time check is acceptable only if the dispatch gate still blocks it -- state that per bypass, but still flag it. Complete PASS/FAIL per HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md. Do not commit; leave no files in lib/ test/ web/ modified.
